invariants.title: Facing
invariants.rule: Terra faces screen-right (toward him); the esper faces screen-right (toward him), as the set's frames draw them.
invariants.why: a take keeps the facing its two frames give it; the duel's were mirrored by a bug

invariants.title: It starts where the last shot ended
invariants.why: a relay: each leg takes the moment from the one before

invariants.title: Its leg of the relay: reveal
invariants.rule: The payoff, from the angle that shows it best - story time 24 to 28 s.
invariants.why: LTX_PLAYBOOK §101: every shot is a leg of one moment; an echo repeats time already told

invariants.title: It rises BEHIND her
invariants.rule: Out of the fire at her back; she stays in front of it, small, palms together.

invariants.title: It is the esper of the sheet
invariants.rule: Horned, obsidian skin cracked with lava, a mane of fire, white-gold eyes.

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: each leg's length is its share of the story time

title: it rises
beat: The reveal: the esper, from in front of her - she is small, it is everything behind her. [reveal · story t 24-28 s] (shot 10 of 23)
build: frames first in the clearing set (set_test.py render + cast --ends), H3 between the set's two frames (set_film.py takes) - the camera, the marks and the facing come from the set; the place's state from the shot's dress
